role: Frozen analytic geometry and input-contract checks before the first authored-fixture CLI projection; not recorded KITTI accuracy evaluation

geometry.pixel_chain: q = P_rect_selected * embed(R_rect_00) * T_cam0_from_velo * [X_velo,1]; pixel = q.xy / q.z
geometry.rectified_offset_m: inverse(A) * b, retaining skew and all three fourth-column entries
geometry.native_K_D_R_T_and_selected_R_rect: retained as provenance; never additionally applied to already rectified processed pixels
geometry.inframe: camera depth > 0 and 0 <= u < width and 0 <= v < height; no inclusion epsilon
geometry.outside: positive camera depth with a finite pixel outside the half-open canvas
geometry.behind: nonpositive camera depth; pixel is null

input_contract.calibration: ASCII row-major standard raw calibration fields for all four cameras and Velodyne/IMU rigid transforms; unknown/duplicate/missing/nonfinite/wrong-cardinality fields fail
input_contract.compatibility_metadata: calib_time, corner_dist, delta_f and delta_c are nonoperational metadata where declared by the parser; literal real-file compatibility remains unverified
input_contract.calibration_identity: Input hashes identify supplied files; they do not authenticate factory calibration, a common acquisition day or archive membership. calib_time processing metadata may differ across files
input_contract.points: 1..200000 little-endian float32 records, each 16 bytes containing XYZ metres and reflectance; every value finite; every row retained
input_contract.output: Exclusive fresh output, no symlink parents or dot/parent components, admitted before calibration/point reads. Failed later input validation can retain an empty reserved output; never overwrite an earlier result

authored_fixture.role: Original analytical calibration and point bytes, not measured KITTI data or ground truth
authored_fixture.coverage: Nonidentity shared R_rect_00, distinct per-camera R_rect_i, distinct native/rectified intrinsics, intrinsic skew, nonzero x/y/z fourth column, exact image boundaries, positive/zero/negative depth and out-of-frame points
authored_fixture.independent_auditor: NumPy homogeneous matrix products/inverses, reconstructed from supplied calibration and point bytes; compare every row, transforms, provenance and summaries
authored_fixture.negative_controls: Actual CLI input/output admission failures plus audit mutations of projection order, fourth column, calibration/source identities, units, frame metadata and retained rows
authored_fixture.freeze: Design committed before first fixture CLI invocation; source/fixture/executable identities retained before invocation; no post-result fixture or tolerance tuning

acquisition_status: Official anonymous documentation acquired; raw-data page requires login. No KITTI raw calibration, Velodyne recording, camera image, OXTS pose, devkit or measured scene score acquired
maturity: Analytic adapter checks do not establish automotive perception/localization accuracy or the 30% maturity goal
